acceptance: Red test first: a staged merge of origin/main into a branch whose own diff against main is only Markdown under docs/ passes with --reviewers docs-review.
Red test first: --files limits the review decision and the waiver check, not only the lane files.
A merge whose own diff against the first parent's merge base adds code still needs the code reviewers.
Docs in STE: the commitgate package note records the merge rule.
fix: changeListing ignores Options.Files, and the gate has no merge handling, so a merge of main counts each main file (for example the release binary go/evolve and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json) as new change. Route --files through changeListing. When MERGE_HEAD exists, judge the branch's own change: the diff of the merge result against the merge-in parent.
notes: Console route: commit gate. Seen on PR #1227 on 2026-11-02; the work-around was a fresh docs-only branch (#1230).
source: console, 2026-11-02, PR #1227 sync with main after v23.0.0
summary: A merge of origin/main into a docs PR failed the commit gate: the gate read main's release files as new change and asked for code reviewers, and --files did not change the review decision.
title: The commit gate judges a merge of main by the branch's own change, and --files reaches the review decision
